skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this text into a short video clip with visuals and background music —...

latestVersion.changelog:
DeepSeek Text to Video Free — v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly generate short videos with visuals and background music from text prompts or uploaded files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, plain text, up to 200MB).
- Seamless cloud-based rendering — nothing to install, just connect and start creating.
- Automatic user onboarding with free, time-limited tokens for video generation.
- Session management for iterative editing, file uploads, export, and tracking credits/balance.
- Supports exporting videos in multiple formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, etc.) and polling for job completion.
- Built-in error handling and helpful status updates to guide you through the workflow.
